features.name: bond_weighted_charge_transfer_gap
features.source:
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    props = [p.get(a.get('element')) or {} for a in sites]
    r = [a.get('covalent_radius_A') for a in props]
    en = [a.get('eneg') for a in props]
    ie = [a.get('first_ionization_energy_eV') for a in props]
    ea = [a.get('electron_affinity_eV') for a in props]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            if r[i] is not None and r[j] is not None and r[i] > 0 and r[j] > 0 and en[i] is not None and en[j] is not None and abs(en[i] - en[j]) > 0.1:
                donor = i if en[i] < en[j] else j
                acceptor = j if donor == i else i
                if ie[donor] is not None and ea[acceptor] is not None:
                    w = occ[i] * occ[j] * max(1.5 - d / (r[i] + r[j]), 0.0) ** 2 / d
                    total += w * (ie[donor] - ea[acceptor])
                    weight += w
    return total / weight if weight > 0 else 0.0
features.description: Short-contact-weighted donor ionization energy minus acceptor electron affinity, oriented by electronegativity.

features.name: electronegative_covalent_capacity_deficit
features.source:
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    props = [p.get(a.get('element')) or {} for a in sites]
    r = [a.get('covalent_radius_A') for a in props]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    cn = [0.0] * n
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            if r[i] is not None and r[j] is not None and r[i] > 0 and r[j] > 0:
                ratio = d / (r[i] + r[j])
                cn[i] += occ[j] * min(max((1.5 - ratio) / 0.4, 0.0), 1.0)
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        g = props[i].get('group')
        en = props[i].get('eneg')
        if g is not None and 14 <= g <= 17 and en is not None and en >= 2.3 and r[i] is not None and r[i] > 0:
            capacity = float(18 - g)
            deficit = max(1.0 - cn[i] / capacity, 0.0)
            total += occ[i] * deficit * deficit
            weight += occ[i]
    return total / weight if weight > 0 else 0.0
features.description: Mean squared fractional deficit of short-contact coordination relative to electronegative main-group covalent capacities.

features.name: short_bond_chemical_ordering_excess
features.source:
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    r = [(p.get(a.get('element')) or {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for a in sites]
    en = [(p.get(a.get('element')) or {}).get('eneg') for a in sites]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    weight = 0.0
    total = 0.0
    square = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if en[i] is not None and r[i] is not None and r[i] > 0:
            weight += occ[i]
            total += occ[i] * en[i]
            square += occ[i] * en[i] * en[i]
    if weight <= 0:
        return 0.0
    mean = total / weight
    baseline = 2.0 * max(square / weight - mean * mean, 0.0)
    if baseline <= 1e-10:
        return 0.0
    contacts = 0.0
    contrast = 0.0
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            if en[i] is not None and en[j] is not None and r[i] is not None and r[j] is not None and r[i] > 0 and r[j] > 0:
                w = occ[i] * occ[j] * max(1.5 - d / (r[i] + r[j]), 0.0) ** 2
                contacts += w
                contrast += w * (en[i] - en[j]) ** 2
    return contrast / (contacts * baseline) - 1.0 if contacts > 0 else 0.0
features.description: Short-contact electronegativity contrast relative to random mixing of the occupied-site composition.

features.name: local_neighbor_chemical_diversity
features.source:
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    r = [(p.get(a.get('element')) or {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for a in sites]
    en = [(p.get(a.get('element')) or {}).get('eneg') for a in sites]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    weights = [0.0] * n
    totals = [0.0] * n
    squares = [0.0] * n
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            if en[j] is not None and r[i] is not None and r[j] is not None and r[i] > 0 and r[j] > 0:
                w = occ[j] * max(1.5 - d / (r[i] + r[j]), 0.0) ** 2
                weights[i] += w
                totals[i] += w * en[j]
                squares[i] += w * en[j] * en[j]
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if weights[i] > 1e-12:
            mean = totals[i] / weights[i]
            total += occ[i] * max(squares[i] / weights[i] - mean * mean, 0.0)
            weight += occ[i]
    return sqrt(total / weight) if weight > 0 else 0.0
features.description: Root mean within-site variance of neighbor electronegativity, weighted by occupied short contacts.

features.name: coulomb_assisted_charge_transfer_drive

def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    props = [p.get(a.get('element')) or {} for a in sites]
    r = [a.get('covalent_radius_A') for a in props]
    en = [a.get('eneg') for a in props]
    ie = [a.get('first_ionization_energy_eV') for a in props]
    ea = [a.get('electron_affinity_eV') for a in props]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            if r[i] is not None and r[j] is not None and r[i] > 0 and r[j] > 0 and en[i] is not None and en[j] is not None and abs(en[i] - en[j]) > 0.1:
                donor = i if en[i] < en[j] else j
                acceptor = j if donor == i else i
                if ie[donor] is not None and ea[acceptor] is not None:
                    w = occ[i] * occ[j] * max(1.5 - d / (r[i] + r[j]), 0.0) ** 2

features.name: local_contact_size_mismatch
features.source:
def feature(s):
    if not s:
        return 0.0
    sites = s.get('sites') or []
    n = len(sites)
    p = s.get('element_properties') or {}
    r = [(p.get(a.get('element')) or {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for a in sites]
    occ = [max(a.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0, 0.0) for a in sites]
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for b in s.get('neighbors') or []:
        i = b.get('i', -1)
        j = b.get('j', -1)
        d = b.get('distance_A') or 0.0
        if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and d > 1e-8:
            if r[i] is not None and r[j] is not None and r[i] > 0 and r[j] > 0:
                radius_sum = r[i] + r[j]
                w = occ[i] * occ[j] * max(1.5 - d / radius_sum, 0.0) ** 2
                mismatch = (r[i] - r[j]) / radius_sum
                total += w * mismatch * mismatch
                weight += w
    return total / weight if weight > 0 else 0.0
features.description: Short-contact-weighted squared fractional covalent-radius mismatch between neighboring atoms.
